**fireside** - self-hosted text-to-audio for long-form reading.
Drop in an EPUB or paste a public story link (Archive of Our Own, and general web pages) and fireside narrates it chapter by chapter, with per-chapter audio you can replay plus a continuous whole-book mode. No subscription wall, no account required.
Bring your own speech engine: Azure, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MiniMax, or a local engine such as Kokoro, which makes it cost nothing per word. Metadata runs on SQLite by default, or MySQL/MariaDB if you prefer.
Open source, MIT licensed. This repository holds the Community Applications template for the fireside Docker image.
Support and issues: https://github.com/magic-smoke-technologies-llc/fireside/issues
